I saw in sazón alegre un tierno pecho

ufano sweetmandnte with mand pina,

and that anudarnos could in su caofna

el anda cortés love with lazo estrecho.


I veo el biin that andourve anda ofshecho,

and mand segura fe of cuitas llina,

and that el ingrato in impío afán withofna

a quiin halla in su agrasawo satisfecho.


I saw that no I was indigno of la gloria

that in su rigor me usurpa la mudanza,

and in sombra ofl olsawdo anda me veo.


intristézcome ifempre in la memoria,

ofsfallezco medroso in la espwasnza,

and al ind pierdo la life in el ofifre.
